constraints.name: profiles_email_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (email)

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: profiles_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: profiles_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'banned'::text]))

constraints.name: gen_action_billing_mode
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR (billing_mode = ANY (ARRAY['debit'::text, 'free_quota'::text])))

constraints.name: gen_action_bound_has_task
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR provider_submission_state <> 'bound'::text OR status = 'completed'::text OR task_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: gen_action_completed_has_output
constraints.definition:
CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR status <> 'completed'::text OR
CASE
    WHEN type = 'text'::text THEN output_text IS NOT NULL
    ELSE output_oss_key IS NOT NULL
END)

constraints.name: gen_action_credit_nonnegative
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR credit_cost IS NOT NULL AND credit_cost >= 0)

constraints.name: gen_action_fingerprint_version
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR fingerprint_version = 'canvas-generation-v1'::text)

constraints.name: gen_action_free_quota_zero_cost
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR billing_mode <> 'free_quota'::text OR credit_cost = 0)

constraints.name: gen_action_identity_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR canvas_id_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND canvas_node_id IS NOT NULL AND canvas_rev IS NOT NULL AND writer_tag IS NOT NULL AND request_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND pricing_version IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: gen_action_kind_canonical
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR (type = ANY (ARRAY['video'::text, 'image'::text, 'text'::text])) AND generation_type = type)

constraints.name: gen_action_kind_profile_shape
constraints.definition:
CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR
CASE
    WHEN type = 'text'::text THEN reconcile_profile_version IS NULL AND reconcile_interval_ms IS NULL AND next_reconcile_at IS NULL AND reconcile_owner IS NULL AND reconcile_lease_token IS NULL AND reconcile_lease_expires_at IS NULL
    ELSE reconcile_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND reconcile_interval_ms IS NOT NULL AND reconcile_interval_ms > 0
END)

constraints.name: gen_action_not_started_is_clean
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR provider_submission_state <> 'not_started'::text OR task_id IS NULL AND submission_token_hash IS NULL AND submission_started_at IS NULL)

constraints.name: gen_action_output_shape
constraints.definition:
CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR
CASE
    WHEN type = 'text'::text THEN output_oss_key IS NULL
    ELSE output_text IS NULL AND (output_oss_key IS NULL OR output_oss_key = planned_output_oss_key)
END)

constraints.name: gen_action_planned_key_shape
constraints.definition:
CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR
CASE
    WHEN type = 'text'::text THEN planned_output_oss_key IS NULL
    ELSE planned_output_oss_key IS NOT NULL
END)

constraints.name: gen_action_refund_bounded
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR credits_refunded IS NOT NULL AND credits_refunded >= 0 AND credits_refunded <= credit_cost)

constraints.name: gen_action_source_canvas
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR source = 'canvas'::text)

constraints.name: gen_action_status_canonical
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'processing'::text, 'completed'::text, 'failed'::text])))

constraints.name: gen_action_submission_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (action_id IS NULL OR (provider_submission_state = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::text, 'submitting'::text, 'bound'::text, 'unknown'::text])))

constraints.name: gen_reconcile_attempts_nonnegative
constraints.definition: CHECK (reconcile_attempt_count >= 0)

constraints.name: gen_reconcile_lease_all_or_none
constraints.definition: CHECK (reconcile_owner IS NULL AND reconcile_lease_token IS NULL AND reconcile_lease_expires_at IS NULL OR reconcile_owner IS NOT NULL AND reconcile_lease_token IS NOT NULL AND reconcile_lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: gen_reconcile_profile_all_or_none
constraints.definition: CHECK (reconcile_profile_version IS NULL AND reconcile_interval_ms IS NULL OR reconcile_profile_version IS NOT NULL AND reconcile_interval_ms IS NOT NULL AND reconcile_interval_ms > 0)

constraints.name: generations_canvas_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES canvases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: generations_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: generations_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id)

constraints.name: valid_library_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (library_status IS NULL OR (library_status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'ready'::text, 'published'::text])))

constraints.name: valid_source
constraints.definition: CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['quick_gen'::text, 'batch_image'::text, 'image_factory'::text, 'pro_studio'::text, 'link_video'::text, 'viral_clone'::text, 'ecom_factory'::text, 'studio'::text, 'slideshow'::text, 'photo_post'::text, 'canvas'::text])) OR source ~~ 'batch_video%'::text) NOT VALID

constraints.name: canvases_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: canvases_share_slug_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (share_slug)

constraints.name: canvases_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'archived'::text]))

constraints.name: canvases_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: credit_transactions_canvas_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id) REFERENCES canvases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: credit_transactions_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES profiles(id)

constraints.name: credit_transactions_generation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (generation_id) REFERENCES generations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: credit_transactions_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: credit_transactions_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (type = ANY (ARRAY['purchase'::text, 'usage'::text, 'refund'::text, 'bonus'::text, 'admin_adjustment'::text]))

constraints.name: credit_transactions_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: ct_action_identity_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR entry_kind = 'grant'::text OR generation_id IS NOT NULL AND action_id IS NOT NULL AND canvas_id_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND canvas_node_id IS NOT NULL OR generation_id IS NULL AND action_id IS NULL AND canvas_id_snapshot IS NULL AND canvas_node_id IS NULL AND task_id IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(task_id)) > 0)

constraints.name: ct_balance_delta_consistent
constraints.definition: CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR balance_after = (balance_before + amount))

constraints.name: ct_balance_nonnegative
constraints.definition: CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR balance_before >= 0 AND balance_after >= 0)

constraints.name: ct_entry_kind_canonical
constraints.definition: CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR (entry_kind = ANY (ARRAY['consume'::text, 'refund'::text, 'free_usage'::text, 'grant'::text])))

constraints.name: ct_entry_kind_type_amount_map
constraints.definition: CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR entry_kind = 'consume'::text AND type = 'usage'::text AND amount < 0 OR entry_kind = 'free_usage'::text AND type = 'usage'::text AND amount = 0 OR entry_kind = 'refund'::text AND type = 'refund'::text AND amount > 0 OR entry_kind = 'grant'::text AND type = 'bonus'::text AND amount > 0)

constraints.name: ct_entry_requires_anchor
constraints.definition: CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR operation_anchor IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(operation_anchor)) > 0)

constraints.name: ct_free_usage_quota_identity
constraints.definition:
CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR
CASE
    WHEN entry_kind = 'free_usage'::text THEN quota_key IS NOT NULL AND quota_window_start IS NOT NULL
    ELSE quota_key IS NULL AND quota_window_start IS NULL
END)

constraints.name: ct_grant_has_no_generation
constraints.definition: CHECK (entry_kind IS NULL OR entry_kind <> 'grant'::text OR generation_id IS NULL AND action_id IS NULL)

indexes.name: generations_user_action_uniq

indexes.name: generations_canvas_node_action_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX generations_canvas_node_action_idx ON public.generations USING btree (canvas_id, canvas_node_id, action_id) WHERE (action_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: generations_reconcile_due_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX generations_reconcile_due_idx ON public.generations USING btree (next_reconcile_at) WHERE ((action_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'processing'::text])))

indexes.name: generations_submitting_started_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX generations_submitting_started_idx ON public.generations USING btree (submission_started_at) WHERE ((action_id IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_submission_state = 'submitting'::text))

indexes.name: canvases_share_slug_key

indexes.name: idx_canvases_user_updated
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_canvases_user_updated ON public.canvases USING btree (user_id, updated_at DESC)

indexes.name: credit_transactions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_transactions_pkey ON public.credit_transactions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_credit_transactions_type

indexes.name: idx_credit_transactions_user_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_credit_transactions_user_id ON public.credit_transactions USING btree (user_id)

indexes.name: credit_transactions_user_anchor_uniq
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_transactions_user_anchor_uniq ON public.credit_transactions USING btree (user_id, operation_anchor) WHERE (operation_anchor IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: credit_transactions_consume_anchor_uniq
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_transactions_consume_anchor_uniq ON public.credit_transactions USING btree (generation_id) WHERE ((generation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (entry_kind = ANY (ARRAY['consume'::text, 'free_usage'::text])))

indexes.name: credit_transactions_refund_anchor_uniq
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_transactions_refund_anchor_uniq ON public.credit_transactions USING btree (generation_id) WHERE ((generation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (entry_kind = 'refund'::text))

indexes.name: credit_transactions_quota_usage_uniq
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX credit_transactions_quota_usage_uniq ON public.credit_transactions USING btree (user_id, quota_key, quota_window_start, generation_id) WHERE (entry_kind = 'free_usage'::text)

indexes.name: credit_transactions_generation_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX credit_transactions_generation_idx ON public.credit_transactions USING btree (generation_id) WHERE (generation_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: generation_quota_buckets_key_nonblank
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(btrim(quota_key)) > 0)

constraints.name: generation_quota_buckets_limit_positive
constraints.definition: CHECK (quota_limit > 0)

constraints.name: generation_quota_buckets_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (user_id, quota_key, window_start)

constraints.name: generation_quota_buckets_used_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (used >= 0 AND used <= quota_limit)

constraints.name: generation_quota_buckets_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: generation_quota_buckets_v1_limit_pinned
constraints.definition: CHECK (quota_key <> 'canvas-deepseek-v1'::text OR quota_limit = 20)

constraints.name: generation_quota_buckets_window_utc_day
constraints.definition: CHECK (window_start = (date_trunc('day'::text, (window_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))

indexes.name: generation_quota_buckets_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX generation_quota_buckets_pkey ON public.generation_quota_buckets USING btree (user_id, quota_key, window_start)
